Subject: Re: Next steps: payee activation for Lumen Logistics

Hi Alyssa —

Appreciate the form and W-9. Quick answers and next steps from our side:

1) Invoice routing fields
- We will map incoming invoices to the PO field "order_id" in our accounting pipeline. Please include the PO number in the invoice header and the line-item references in the body. If invoices come from multiple Lumen sub-entities, add the subsidiary code in the "memo" field.

2) Bank details & secure transfer
- Please do not email full bank account numbers. Use our secure upload portal (link below) to submit the bank letter or voided check. If you prefer SFTP, let me know and I’ll loop in our security operations.

Secure upload: https://secure.redwood.com/vendor-upload (one-time token expires in 24h)
Attached: micro-deposit-instructions.pdf (short stub)

3) Micro-deposit protocol
- We will send two micro-deposits up to $0.10 to validate the account. When you confirm the amounts (or upload a screenshot), we’ll flip the vendor to live for ACH. Please also confirm the bank’s ACH routing preference for same-day vs next-day processing if applicable.

4) Timing
- If we get the bankproof + micro-deposit confirmation by EOD Thurs (12/7), we can include Lumen in our Dec 20 pay-run.

Let us know if you want a short checklist call; otherwise we’ll proceed as outlined.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
